Name: SESSION_RANDOM_ASSET_TEX_REPLACE_PARAM_ST
Description: Random asset texture swaps per session: for the session's key, one group of rows is drawn and each row's texture pairs are applied.

Fields.Name: Session Key
Fields.Description: The row is a candidate only when this equals the session's texture key (998 in one special session type). Retail: 10-190, 998, 999.

Fields.Name: Group
Fields.Description: Candidate rows with the same value form a group; one group is drawn at random per session and all its rows apply. Retail: one group per key (0, or the key itself for keys 140 and 160-190), so retail never draws between groups.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 1 - Replaced Texture
Fields.Description: Texture that is replaced in this session, e.g. AET801_250: any asset texture whose name starts with these 10 characters loads Texture Pair 1 - Replacement instead. Must be exactly 10 characters and pass the game's texture-name check, or the pair is skipped.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 1 - Replacement
Fields.Description: Texture loaded in place of Texture Pair 1 - Replaced Texture (the rest of the texture name is kept). Same rules. Retail: always an AET550 texture.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 2 - Replaced Texture
Fields.Description: A second swap applied by the same row, as pair 1. Retail: empty on every row.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 2 - Replacement
Fields.Description: Texture loaded in place of Texture Pair 2 - Replaced Texture. Retail: empty on every row.
